content: These Water Elemetal ingots always leave your workstation wet after you tinkered with them, time to turn this annoyance into something useful.
While tending to your crops, wondering where you can use these characteristics, you're struck by inspiration: A hoe!
The instant you swing the Water hoe for the first time, you know it was meant to be. The hoe turned not one, but 9 blocks into farmland.
Although this farmland do be looking a bit different from your regular farmland. Maybe the Tome will learn more about that after making some yourself?
